verdict.rationale: Drata's docs show the core SOC 2 building blocks — Controls, Policies (Policy Center), Risk Assessment, Monitoring Tests, Audits, and integrations for evidence collection — indicating an end-to-end compliance program platform. However, the evidence pack never explicitly mentions Trust Services Criteria mapping or distinguishes Type I vs Type II audit support, so the specific framework-coverage claims in the story aren't directly confirmed. Missing for 10: explicit Trust Services Criteria/category mapping, explicit Type I vs Type II audit workflow documentation, and independent verification of evidence-request automation end-to-end.
